Consent.title: Cookies on Faroz
Consent.body: Faroz uses only the cookies it needs to work. It uses no analytics or marketing cookies today. You can choose now what is allowed if that changes.
Consent.dialogIntro: Choose which optional cookies Faroz may use. You can change this at any time from the footer.

necessary.title: Necessary
necessary.text: Keeps you signed in and remembers your language, theme and unsent quiz answers. Faroz cannot work without them.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.text: Would count visits and show how the site is used. Faroz does not use analytics today.

marketing.title: Marketing
marketing.text: Would be used for ads or tracking across sites. Faroz does not use marketing cookies today.

Consent.noneToday: Faroz does not use analytics or marketing cookies today. These switches only record your choice for the future.
Consent.privacyCookies: More about the cookies and browser storage Faroz uses, and how to change your choice, is on the cookie policy page.

CookiePolicy.title: Cookie policy
CookiePolicy.intro: A factual list of the cookies and browser storage Faroz uses, what each one is for, and how long it lasts.
CookiePolicy.legalNote: This is a draft for a course project. It has not had legal review for any specific country, and Faroz does not claim to meet any particular cookie law.
CookiePolicy.listTitle: What Faroz stores in your browser

rows.session: Keeps you signed in as a learner or teacher. Set by the Faroz server and not readable by page scripts (HttpOnly).
rows.staff: Keeps you signed in to a center workspace. Set by the Faroz server and not readable by page scripts (HttpOnly).
rows.locale: Remembers the language you chose (Russian, Tajik or English).
rows.consent: Remembers your cookie choice so Faroz does not ask again.
rows.theme: Remembers whether you use the dark or the light theme.
rows.notify: Remembers that you dismissed the prompt to turn on notifications on this device.
rows.quest: Keeps your unsent quiz answers if you reload the page. The key ends with the quiz name. It is removed when you submit.

CookiePolicy.optionalBody: Analytics and marketing are the optional categories. Faroz uses neither today: it has no analytics tools, no advertising and no third-party trackers. If that ever changes, the notice will ask you again before anything optional is switched on.
CookiePolicy.manageBody: You can see, change or withdraw your choice at any time. You can also delete cookies and site data in your browser settings; you will then be signed out and asked about cookies again.
